title: Yellow Molten Brazilian Peanut Butter Pasta
description: A tangy and comforting Brazilian dish featuring peanut butter in a rich and creamy sauce, served with al-dente pasta in a copper pot.
instructions: Bring a large copper pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al-dente.
In a blender or food processor, combine peanut butter, butter, garlic, onion, coconut milk, curry powder, salt, and pepper, and blend until smooth.
In the same copper pot, add the blended peanut butter sauce and stir over low heat until the sauce is warm and molten.
Add the cooked pasta to the copper pot and toss to combine with the peanut butter sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Let the pasta rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the sauce to set.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
